items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: I just did a record with Bobby Short, and a double album with Benny Carter that is “The Benny Carter Songbook”

ctx.x: I was out working on my car. I was draining the oil from my little Fiat. My old man comes out and says, “It’s the phone for you.” And I went in and said, “Hello?” And the voice said, “This is Benny.” Of course I said, “Benny who?” I couldn’t believe it was Benny Goodman. Benny Goodman called me personally. Bang — I was up there, and for the next ten years or so on and off, I worked with Benny Goodman off and on in varying combinations.
